summary: Habit tracker needs correct monthly volume totals by summing ticked/completed days, with per-habit per-month target values (Plank increases +15s each month after February; Squash fixed at 45 minutes).
known_issues: Plank and Squash habit volumes are not currently adding up correctly when days are ticked/completed.

existing_features.title: Fix Plank time progression so that February is the base month at 1:15, and each month after February increases the *daily* Plank target by +15 seconds (e.g., Mar = 1:30, Apr = 1:45), without incorrectly treating the increment as minutes.
Keep Squash daily target fixed at 45:00 across all months (no month-to-month compounding), and ensure that this fixed value is used when calculating monthly totals from completed/ticked days.

Ensure monthly totals for all habits (including Plank and Squash) are calculated as: (number of ticked/completed days in the selected month) × (that habit’s per-day target for the selected month), and displayed correctly in each habit row and in the Monthly Volume Summary.

new_feature_requests.summary: Auto-calculate monthly volume totals by summing values for days marked ticked/completed (for Plank and other habits)
Support month-based Plank daily target that increases by +15 seconds each month after February (e.g., Feb 1:15, Mar 1:30, Apr 1:45) and use it in monthly volume calculation
Keep Squash daily value fixed at 45 minutes and include it in monthly volume calculation based on ticked/completed days

projectName: Fix Plank & Squash monthly volumes: sum ticked days and apply correct month-based targets (Plank +15s after Feb, Squash fixed 45:00)
